energy_path.mechanism: Seven of the visible characters are water and the month and day branches both sit at imperial-prosperity grade for water, so you start every situation with more raw drive and faster circulation than the scene requires. This is the only true gain segment: abundant, self-renewing energy that does not need external fuel.

Companion and Rob Wealth together dominate everything else combined. When energy moves, it moves sideways into people like you — partners, rivals, group discussion — instead of outward. Each exchange returns agreement rather than product, which feels like progress and moves nothing outside the circle.

Output is the one channel that converts water into visible work: Eating God as the hidden Yi wood in the year branch, plus a small Hurting Officer thread in the hidden Jia of the two Hai branches. When a task pleases you, water leaves the peer circuit as polished craft. This gain is real but narrow — the channel carries only a fraction of the volume behind it.

Wealth, Officer and Killings, and Resource all weigh zero natively. Nothing in the structure converts finished work into holdings, reputation, or enforced commitments. Even when the outlet fires, the product tends to circulate back into the peer group instead of accumulating as something an outsider can point to.

The luck sequence adds metal and water through the age-9, age-19 and age-29 stretches — deepening the existing field — then brings the first sustained earth and fire at the age-49 and age-59 pillars. Earth and fire act as demand and structure this configuration has never met, forcing energy out of the peer circuit. Whether that forcing reads as pressure or as finally shipping depends on what you built before it arrives.

leverage.point: The enjoyment-gated outlet: the Eating God hidden in the year branch wood.
leverage.input: One self-chosen task you genuinely find interesting, carried to a finished, shippable state.
leverage.output: Disproportionate visible craft from a small unit of deliberate effort — because the same input that peers absorb as discussion becomes, through this channel, a thing others can hold.
leverage.why: The chart's energy is abundant but has exactly one narrow exit. Peer circulation absorbs most of it and returns agreement, which banks nothing. Routing even a small stream through the outlet instead of the peer circuit changes the ratio sharply, because the outlet is the only place where water turns into work. The leverage is not in working harder — the water supply is not the constraint — but in which circuit each unit of effort enters.

vulnerability.point: The peer circuit with no exit: Companion and Rob Wealth feeding themselves.
vulnerability.condition: Environments made entirely of equals in conversation — committees without deadlines, co-founder groups without clients, communities where discussion is the activity — combined with your own rule that shipping should wait 'until it is better'.
vulnerability.mechanism: With Wealth weighing zero, nothing internal demands proof of output; with Officer and Killings weighing zero, no external authority forces a check before you commit. Your judgment forms inside your own head, peers mirror it back, and the mirror counts as confirmation. Energy circulates, agreement accumulates, and the outlet only opens on enjoyment — so assigned or dull work barely starts while interesting work stays inside the group. The structure does not collapse; it runs at full volume with almost nothing leaving, which wears you down as continuous room-reading effort spent on staying aligned rather than making anything.
vulnerability.self_check: After any stretch of work or conversation, ask one question: did energy leave the circuit as a written thing, a sold thing, or a signed thing? If a month passes where the answer is repeatedly no while the discussion felt valuable, the loop is running closed. Also notice when your certainty comes only from people who already agreed with you before you spoke.

upgrade_path.entry_condition: You can observe one concrete exchange — a meeting, a chat thread, a project discussion — and name what, if anything, it produced that someone outside the group could hold.
upgrade_path.work: For a fixed period, log every peer exchange and mark it shipped or circulated. No behavior change yet; only the tracking. The chart supplies no internal demand for proof, so the log must replace that missing function manually.
upgrade_path.done_signal: You can predict, before an exchange starts, whether it will end in a deliverable or in agreement — and you are right most of the time.

upgrade_path.entry_condition: The log shows a clear pattern of circulated-versus-shipped, and you have at least one task you genuinely enjoy.
upgrade_path.work: Attach a deliverable requirement to every exchange that matters: a written decision, a prototype, a sent proposal — before the next round of discussion begins. Route the enjoyment-gated outlet deliberately: choose self-defined projects where the interest condition opens the channel, and finish them to a state a stranger can evaluate.
upgrade_path.done_signal: Your default close for a working conversation has become 'who writes this up and by when', said by you, and at least some finished items exist that people outside your circle have seen or used.

upgrade_path.entry_condition: You have shipped a few finished items and felt the difference between circulated and banked energy.
upgrade_path.work: Choose environments and roles that supply what the chart lacks: clients who pay only for finished work, written decision cultures, commitments with dates. This mimics, on your own schedule, the earth-and-fire structure that the luck pillars bring only from the age-49 and age-59 stretches onward. Decline or restructure pure peer-discussion settings.
upgrade_path.done_signal: A meaningful share of your weekly effort is governed by external deliverables rather than by your own interest alone, and the room-reading reflex has shifted from staying aligned to spotting what the demand actually requires.

upgrade_path.phase: Let demand carry the late stretch
upgrade_path.entry_condition: The age-49 and age-59 luck stretches arrive — the earth-and-fire pillars — or equivalent external pressure appears regardless of calendar age.
upgrade_path.work: Treat rising external structure as the forcing function it is for this configuration, not as interference. Hand more of your judgment to systems — contracts, published work, processes with checkpoints — so the Officer and Wealth functions the natal chart never supplied are carried by structures you built rather than by willpower.
upgrade_path.done_signal: Your reads and your products have fused: people encounter your judgment through things you shipped, not through conversations you won, and the peer circuit has become one input among several rather than the whole engine.
